q-141493.name: Question 1
q-141493.worked_solution:
We apply the product rule for radicals, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\sqrt{14u}\cdot \sqrt{v} & = \\ \sqrt{14u\cdot v} & = \\ \sqrt{14uv}\end{aligned}

q-141845.name: Question 3
q-141845.worked_solution:
We perform the multiplication under a single radical and then simplify the result:

$$
\begin{aligned}\sqrt{16w}\cdot 3\sqrt{9{w}^{3}} & = \\ 3\sqrt{16w\cdot 9{w}^{3}} & = \\ 3\sqrt{144{w}^{4}} & = \\ 3\sqrt{(12{w}^{2})^{2}} & = \\ 3|12{w}^{2}| & = \\ 3\cdot |12|\cdot |{w}^{2}| & = \\ 3\cdot 12\cdot |{w}^{2}| & = \\ 36\cdot |{w}^{2}|\end{aligned}
$$

A squared number is always positive or zero, and the absolute value of any positive (or zero) number is itself, so we have

$$
\begin{aligned}36\cdot |{w}^{2}| & =36{w}^{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

?

a
3w2
b
123w2
c
2w2
d
12w2
e
36w2
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

We perform the multiplication under a single radical and then simplify the result: 16w⋅39w3=316w⋅9w3=3144w4=3(12w2)2=3|12w2|=3⋅|12|⋅|w2|=3⋅12⋅|w2|=36⋅|w2|

A squared number is always positive or zero, and the absolute value of any positive (or zero) number is itself, so we have 36⋅|w2|=36w2.

q-110957.name: Question 4
q-110957.worked_solution:
We perform the multiplication under a single radical and then simplify the result:

$$
\begin{aligned}\sqrt{3z}\cdot \sqrt{5{z}^{6}} & = \\ \sqrt{3z\cdot 5{z}^{6}} & = \\ \sqrt{{z}^{6}\cdot 15z} & = \\ \sqrt{{({z}^{3})}^{2}\cdot 15z} & = \\ \sqrt{{({z}^{3})}^{2}}\cdot \sqrt{15z} & = \\ |{z}^{3}|\cdot \sqrt{15z} & = \\ |z{|}^{3}\cdot \sqrt{15z} & =\end{aligned}
$$

Since $z\ge 0,$ we have $|z|=z,$ and we can simplify further. Therefore, our final answer is

$$
|z{|}^{3}\cdot \sqrt{15z}={z}^{3}\sqrt{15z}.
$$

a
 z415

z315z

15z3z

z215z

15z4

We perform the multiplication under a single radical and then simplify the result: 3z⋅5z6=3z⋅5z6=z6⋅15z=(z3)2⋅15z=(z3)2⋅15z=|z3|⋅15z=|z|3⋅15z=

q-141931.worked_solution:

$$

$$

q-141846.name: Question 6
q-141846.worked_solution:
We perform the multiplication under a single radical and then simplify the result:

$$
\begin{aligned}\sqrt[3]{x}\cdot \sqrt[3]{8{x}^{2}} & = \\ \sqrt[3]{x\cdot 8{x}^{2}} & = \\ \sqrt[3]{8\cdot {x}^{3}} & = \\ \sqrt[3]{(2x)^{3}} & = \\ 2x\end{aligned}
$$
